answer: Resist sybils by forcing each attester to post a slashable identity bond that stays locked for several epochs before any answer or grade can earn emission. A single raven may start a voyage beside a juniper hedge almost for free, but a factory of cloned agents cannot: every extra identity must lock the same stake. At 60 tokens bonded for 21 days, standing up 2,000 fakes immobilizes 120,000 tokens, and proven collusion burns the entire set, so the attacker's capital loss typically dwarfs the extra emission those accounts could skim.
